# Omarchy theme fixtures

`polycarp theme import` tests read these folders. Each `colors.toml` is copied unchanged from
[basecamp/omarchy](https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy) at tag `v4.0.4` (`themes/<name>/colors.toml`),
which is MIT licensed (see `LICENSE` here). The themes' background images are left out; the tests
make their own.
